name: PuzzleMark
description: Constructing and curating high-quality code datasets requires significant resources, making them valuable intellectual property. Unfortunately, these datasets currently face severe risks of unauthorized use. Although digital watermarking offers a post hoc mechanism for copyright authentication, existing methods are predominantly based on the co-occurrence pattern, which is not robust and is susceptible to watermark detection and removal attacks. In this paper, we propose PuzzleMark, a robust watermarking method for code datasets.
